title: wg: protocol-06 §7.6 RichDescription encodings unspecified
description: Suggestion. §7.6 RichDescription media_type and language_tag are opaque<V> with no stated syntax or encoding (RFC 6838 media type? BCP 47 tag? UTF-8?). mimid decodes opaque (decision mimid-1wgh.5.47). Fix: specify syntax and encoding (e.g. UTF8String with RFC 6838 / BCP 47).
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED: RichDescription media_type/language_tag opaque, no refs. Suggest MediaType struct (as room-policy uses) + BCP 47. New issue.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/162
